2.2 Add root-aware channel pagination/projection, root entry and hidden-reply navigation, preserve drawer state across fetches; document desktop behavior and pass API pagination tests and production build.

3.1 Strictly validate OpenSpec and architecture guards, deploy 5181 and repository daemon, then complete browser acceptance for main-stream roots, nested replies, attachment-only continuation and delayed-send navigation; publish concrete evidence.
